title: Interchanging time and space derivatives of a family that is C² at a point (Schwarz)
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, Φ : ℝ → ℝᴺ → ℝᴺ, t ∈ ℝ and y ∈ ℝᴺ, and suppose (s,x) ↦ Φ s x is C² at (t,y) (ContDiffAt ℝ 2). Then the map s ↦ fderiv ℝ (Φ s) y, from ℝ to the continuous linear maps ℝᴺ → ℝᴺ, has derivative fderiv ℝ (x ↦ deriv (s ↦ Φ s x) t) y at s = t.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (Φ : ℝ → Rn N → Rn N) (t : ℝ) (y : Rn N), ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun p : ℝ × Rn N ↦ Φ p.1 p.2) (t, y) → HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ fderiv ℝ (Φ s) y) (fderiv ℝ (fun x ↦ deriv (fun s ↦ Φ s x) t) y) t
